answer: Join-fee-burn bond: each new identity pays a burned fee. An applicant locks a 70-credit bond, paying a join fee sealed by a cipher tied to its filing key; peers on a whisper channel admit only receipts matching the seal. A pulse heartbeat each epoch keeps it alive. Fees climb per funder: first 40, kth 40+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-cipher ring fails: borrowed seals mismatch. An honest agent pays 40 once.
